summary: Scienjoy Holding Corp (NASDAQ: SJ), via wholly-owned subsidiary Scienjoy Innovation Labs Inc., filed a Form 6-K covering a September 2, 2026 press release announcing entry into a sale and purchase agreement to acquire 239,234,000 ordinary shares, representing a 29.9% stake, of Leader Education Limited (HKSE: 1449.HK), from controlling shareholder Shuren Education Limited, for HK$102.69 million (~US$13.1 million). The transaction is a minority strategic equity investment aimed at integrating Scienjoy's AI capabilities with Leader Education's private higher education services in China. Closing is subject to conditions including satisfactory due diligence, no material breaches, regulatory consents, and continued HKSE listing. Scienjoy independent director Jun Lu also serves as an executive director of Leader Education, making it a related-party transaction. The parties expect closing five business days after conditions are satisfied or waived. What to watch: regulatory approvals and due-diligence outcomes, given the related-party dynamic; risk-arb angle is limited as this is a minority stake purchase.
